segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְקָרֶה סוּכָּתוֹ בְּשַׁפּוּדִין אוֹ בַּאֲרוּכּוֹת הַמִּטָּה, אִם יֵשׁ רֶיוַח בֵּינֵיהֶן כְּמוֹתָן — כְּשֵׁרָה. הַחוֹטֵט בְּגָדִישׁ לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ סוּכָּה — אֵינָהּ סוּכָּה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who roofs his sukka with» metal «skewers or with the long boards of the bed,» which compose its frame, «if there is space between» each one of «them equal to» the width of the skewers or the boards, and if he places fit roofing in those spaces, the sukka is «fit.» In the case of «one who hollows out» and creates a space inside «a stack of grain to establish a sukka for him,» it is «not a sukka.»

moves.summary: Skewers or bed boards with equal gaps: fit
Hollowing out a grain stack: not a sukka

positions.claim: skewers or bed boards with gaps equal to them, filled with fit roofing, make a fit sukka
hollowing out a grain stack does not make a sukka
